candidate_passages.text: The ASPLOS 2025 MELODY study evaluates 265 workloads, four CXL devices, seven latency settings, and five processor platforms. It reports workload- and device-dependent behavior, including microsecond-scale tail latency on some devices even at low utilization.
candidate_passages.candidate_claim: MELODY shows that average bandwidth and latency are insufficient to characterize CXL memory because tail latency and workload tolerance vary across devices and platforms.
